messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — want to capture recurring anti-patterns we hit during the regional game day and assign owners. Short list: 1) cross-region routing sticky rules that kept traffic on failed region, 2) on-demand snapshot gaps (some DBs missed daily snapshot), 3) restore runbook steps unclear for partial-volume restores, 4) no rehearsal owner rotation.

sam: I can own snapshot cadence and verify retention. I'll add a simple cron-based check and an alert if snapshot >24h. ETA end of sprint (2w). @nina do you want the alert in ops runbook?

nina: yes please. I'll add a 'restore dry-run' checklist and schedule quarterly rehearsals. Assigning rotation owners for next 3 game days.

liam: I'll take the routing policy changes — propose a fallback that lowers weight on unhealthy region and fast-cools active sessions. I'll put a draft in PR by Thursday.

maria: action items summary: AM1: snapshot check & alert -> sam -> 2w; AM2: restore dry-run checklist + quarterly rehearsals -> nina -> schedule by end of month; AM3: routing policy PR -> liam -> draft Thu; AM4: postgame error pattern telemetry -> maria -> add evals to console -> 1w.

sam: added basic CLI check to our ops repo:
```bash
# snapshots older than 24h
./tools/check-snapshots --age 24h --projects prod
```
will open PR tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Reminder: game-day rehearsal deploy scheduled for 2026-04-08 15:00UTC. See runbook link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/restore

nina: I'll block 2 hours with oncall and infra to walk through partial-volume restores. Who should be invited? @sam @liam

liam: count me in. Also propose adding a router canary for 10% traffic to validate fallback behavior before full shift.

maria: good. I'll track owners in the remediation board and ping for weekly 15m standups until all AMs closed. Please update PRs/boards with labels: dr-action, owner:@name, eta:YYYY-MM-DD

sam: noted. PR link when open.

nina: scheduling invite now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
